description: Renamed `smithy_aws_core.aio.config.AwsConfigOverrides` to `AsyncAwsConfigOverrides`, and the async chain types `ChainSetup`, `NamedResolver` and `ChainIdentityProvider` to `AsyncChainSetup`, `AsyncNamedResolver` and `AsyncChainIdentityProvider`. Removed the `Async*Provider` chain providers; the built-in providers in `smithy_aws_core.identity.chain.providers` serve both chains.
